Sylvia  screams,  her  eyes  wide,  as  deep  wounds  open  in  her 
hands and neck. By the time she falls, it seems like a mercy. 
Desperate, you run on, gasping for air.

Attempt a Regular POW roll for Norman: if he succeeds, go to 442; 
if he fails, go to 440.
